newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Parking raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Central Parking raised.

text.p: -- Jefferies & Co said raised its rating on Central Parking Corp shares to buy from accumulate following a selloff of the stock that Jefferies attributed to the recently weak equity market and Central Parking's filing for a 4.5 million stock offer.

-- In a statement, Jefferies said the stock is trading at around 20 times its 1998 earnings forecast of $1.25 a share. It views that multiple as attractive given its estimate of 25 percent annual earnings growth in the next two to three years.
-- "This is an attractive buying opportunity in a high quality, predictable growth stock," Jefferies said.
